verdict.rationale: Superset's prompt-first flow turns a plain-language task description into a workspace on its own worktree and branch, where an agent starts work immediately. The orchestrate skill can also split a described migration into independent slices for separate workers. However, the docs show no step that converts a feature or bug description into a structured, scoped spec or task. The prompt goes straight to agent execution. missing for 10: automatic spec/scope generation from intent, documented task decomposition for features/bugs beyond the orchestration example, any independent corroboration of intent-to-task behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have it automatically turned into a scoped implementation task

citations.quote: In the prompt-first flow, describe the task, pick an agent, and create. The agent starts working on your prompt immediately.
Each task runs in its own Git worktree and branch.
The `superset:orchestrate` skill lets one agent coordinate workers in separate workspaces through the Superset CLI.
